blurb: Hawk Ridge Bird Observatory is located at the Hawk Ridge Nature Reserve main overlook in Duluth. Visitors can observe the fall bird migration from the overlook. The site provides detailed directions to the main overlook from various starting points in Duluth and nearby highways.
